description:

We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Parcel delivery has a quality problem the industry has learned to live with. Parcels go missing between depots. Parcels get marked as delivered and never reach the customer. Most carriers treat a steady rate of loss as a cost of doing business. Relay is building the delivery company where that stops being true.

That is harder for us than for most, because nearly everyone who touches a Relay parcel is an independent partner. We can't manage them into performance. We have to build the standards, the evidence and the product that make doing the job well the natural outcome. Engineering builds the product changes you design.

PARTNER EXCELLENCE HIGHLIGHTS

- You own decision-making, not the model: you decide which signals count, which checks become rules, and whether each fix belongs in product, policy or training. The squad lead acts on your calls.

- Most of a parcel's journey happens between scans. How do you prove a handover happened without making the job slower for the people doing it?

- A delivery is marked complete and the customer says it never came. How do you tell a wrong address from a handover that went wrong, and put the fix where it belongs: product, policy or training?

- Some checks can only answer "can't tell". Which are worth making provable, and which should we stop measuring?

- A whole area, not a slice: you decide what evidence a whole network runs on, and the result is on the street the next morning.

- Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Staff Decision Scientist, Partner Excellence at Relay, you'll:

- Decide which Partner Excellence problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

- Design how Partner Excellence decides: which signals count, what evidence the network runs on, and what good looks like.

- Tell the squad lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

- Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

- Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop.

As we create a colorful, capable and cleaner world through chemistry, we invite you to join our team to harness the power of chemistry to shape markets, redefine industries and improve lives for billions of people around the world.
Location: Remote - Belgium, Germany or the Netherlands
Function: Sales | Thermal & Specialized Solutions (TSS)
Travel: Approximately 50% across Benelux, Germany and Northern Europe
Creating essential chemistry that the world needs
At Chemours, our people are redefining how the world thinks of chemistry by approaching everything we do with a commitment to delivering Trusted Chemistry that creates better lives and helps communities thrive.
Powered by chemistry, our products are used in applications that make the products we rely on, processes, and new technologies possible. In key sectors such as clean energy, advanced electronics, high-performance computing and AI, data center cooling, climate friendly cooling, and high-quality paints and coatings for homes and industrial infrastructure, every day people rely on Chemours chemistry for more modern, safe, and sustainable living.
The opportunity
Chemours is seeking a (Senior) Account Manager to join our Thermal & Specialized Solutions business.
In this role, you will manage and develop strategic customer and channel partner relationships across Benelux, Germany and Northern Europe. You will work closely with distributors, OEMs and direct customers while supporting the market transition toward more sustainable cooling and refrigeration solutions.
This is a highly visible customer-facing role that combines relationship management, commercial leadership, channel management and strategic account development.
What you will do

• Manage a portfolio of strategic customers, OEMs and channel partners

• Develop and execute account growth strategies

• Build long-term relationships with key customer stakeholders

• Lead pricing discussions, negotiations and contract renewals

• Identify opportunities for profitability improvement and business growth

• Collaborate with Business Development, Technical Sales, Marketing and Advocacy teams

• Support customers in evaluating and adopting future-focused product solutions

• Analyze market developments and customer requirements

• Represent Chemours at customer meetings, conferences and industry events

• Contribute to regional commercial planning and strategic initiatives

What you bring

• Bachelor’s degree in business, Engineering, Technology, Marketing or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience

• Experience in Account Management, Key Account Management, Technical Sales or B2B commercial roles

• Background within HVAC, refrigeration, cooling, chemicals, industrial products or a related technical market

• Strong commercial negotiation and contract management capabilities

• Experience managing strategic customer relationships

• Ability to work effectively across multiple stakeholders and functions

• Fluency in English and either German and/or French

• Willingness to travel approximately 50%

What we offer
Chemours offers competitive compensation and benefits, which vary by country and level.
As a general guideline, hiring will typically take place around the country-specific midpoint range, depending on experience, technical expertise, language skills and overall fit. Depending on the country, your experience and expertise the range runs between approximately €90.000, - and €120.000,-

• Annual incentive opportunity of ~ 11% (on target)

• Comprehensive benefits package depending on the country

• Employee Stock Purchase Program

• Learning and development opportunities

• Career growth within a global organization

• Remote and flexible working environment

• International collaboration across EMEA and the US

• Opportunity to contribute to more sustainable cooling solutions

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Why Keyrus , Why Now!
Keyrus is an international group of 3,000 experts across 30 countries, built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.
For more than 30 years, we have helped organizations build the data foundations that power intelligent systems. Today, we go further by designing and operationalizing intelligence that delivers measurable business value.
Building AI capabilities is only part of the challenge. Real transformation happens when those capabilities work within existing business systems, data environments, workflows, and processes.
Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates. Industrial discipline connects the two.
Role details
• Location: Colombia (Remote)

• Modality: Full time / Permanent contract

What you'll architect
As a Senior Data Engineer, you'll be the technical lead on modern data platform work for our clients. You'll build the pipelines, models and lakehouse layers that analytics and business teams rely on every day. You'll also be the engineer in the room who asks the hard questions, flags risks early and explains trade-offs in plain language.
This is a consulting role. You'll work directly with client data, analytics and IT teams, in English, often during US business hours.
Your responsibilities

• Build and run lakehouse pipelines on Databricks, using dbt for transformation and managed ingestion tools such as Fivetran.
• Design data models (dimensional, Data Vault or medallion) that analytics and BI teams can use with confidence.
• Lead migrations and integrations from legacy databases and warehouses into a modern platform.
• Build quality, testing and monitoring into every pipeline so issues are caught before business users find them.
• Apply access controls and data protection, including masking and role-based access, in line with governance standards.
• Tune performance and cloud costs, and recommend improvements proactively.
• Write clear documentation and runbooks so other teams can support and extend your work.
• Guide other engineers through code reviews, shared standards and mentoring.

Who you are
You're a hands-on engineer who takes ownership. You don't wait for perfect requirements. You ask questions, propose an approach and keep stakeholders informed. You're consultative and you care as much about the work being used as about it being built well.
What you bring

Experience

• 6+ years in data engineering, including at least 2 leading technical work on client or cross-team projects.

• Strong SQL and Python.

• Hands-on Databricks experience (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, workflows) and dbt.
• Experience migrating data from relational sources such as SQL Server, Oracle or Aurora.
• Solid grasp of data modeling, testing and CI/CD for data.

Consulting and communication skills

• Advanced English (C1 or above), spoken and written, and confidence leading conversations with US-based stakeholders.
• Ability to clarify business requirements and translate them into actionable technical solutions.
• Ability to communicate technical decisions, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations in plain language.
• Proactive problem-solving, initiative, and a solution-oriented mindset.
• Strong ownership of technical delivery and cross-functional collaboration.

Nice to have

• Azure or AWS data services, including Azure Data Factory or Airflow for orchestration.
• Streaming or change data capture (Kafka, Event Hubs, Kinesis).
• Infrastructure as code (Terraform or Bicep).
• Experience supporting Power BI or Tableau teams with semantic or reporting layers.

• Databricks or cloud certifications.

• Previous experience in the Insurance or Healthcare industries.

• You independently deliver scalable, reliable, and secure data solutions aligned with business needs.
• You anticipate risks, propose sustainable solutions, and continuously improve data quality, performance, and cloud costs.
